titles: provider freight rate cards and deterministic rating
capability_summaries: A zero-star MIT logistics/commerce backend with a production-style provider freight-rate subsystem. Rate cards are provider-owned and versioned by origin/destination/mode/currency/effective window; break ladders carry minimum billable weight/volume, unit price, minimum charge and transit ranges; volumetric divisors are explicit per card. The service derives provider identity/provenance from the authenticated organization, prevents caller-supplied source/provider spoofing, supports supersession and audit entries, and the rating layer chooses breaks deterministically with explicit unavailable reasons.
